title: Close out documentation drift for retired and migrated pipeline mechanisms (task-048 + task-035 + decision-004)
description: Close the documentation-drift class left by two completed migrations, plus one stale decision record. task-048 retired bronze_azureSQLdb2table (Dataflow Gen2 -> two Copy activities; the workspace item is DELETED and returns 404) and task-035 earlier moved EPI/WGI ingestion from dataflows to notebooks. Both shipped; neither fully closed its documentation surface, and the two drifts are interleaved in the SAME files, which is why task-048's own attempts to fix its slice kept missing instances. Split out of task-048 by user decision 2026-07-31 after that task escalated at the 3-attempt verification threshold with all 7 of its acceptance criteria passing and only cross-file doc consistency failing.
acceptanceCriteria: The two operational runbooks that route an on-call operator into the DELETED workspace item are fixed first, before anything else: `.claude/support/documents/architecture/data_sources.md` lines ~247-249 and `.claude/commands/run-bronze.md` lines ~107-110, both of which say 'Verify authentication credentials in dataflow' / 'Test connection in dataflow editor'. These are the only findings with live operational impact.

A REPO-WIDE discovery probe is run with NO path restriction and NO output truncation, and its exact command plus its full result count are recorded in the task notes. Piping through `head` is prohibited; narrow by refining the query, never by clipping results. Any path exclusion must be listed WITH its rationale in the same note that reports the result.

The probe is run for the FEATURE CLASS, not just item names — at minimum `dataflow` (case-insensitive), `RefreshDataflow`, and `bronze_procurement` excluding `bronze_procurement_transactional`. An item-name-only probe does not satisfy this criterion.

Every hit the probe returns is dispositioned in one of exactly three ways, with none left unclassified: FIXED, or EXEMPT-with-recorded-reason (archival: `.claude/support/audits/**`, `.claude/tasks/**`, `.claude/support/retired/**`, `project_definition.md` which is marked DEPRECATED; or correctly past-tense prose; or generic dataflow-concept text unrelated to these two migrations), or DEFERRED-to-a-named-follow-up.

task-035's residual drift is closed in the same pass, since it lives in the same files: `.claude/commands/run-silver.md` ~line 178 ('complete task-035 — replace the bronze_WGI RefreshDataflow activity' — task-035 shipped), `.claude/support/documents/external_data_automation.md` ~line 608 ('Pipeline Wiring' listed as pending), `fabric/bronze-to-silver.Notebook/notebook-content.py` ~line 624 (same stale instruction inside an error string), the EPI/WGI '✅ Active' rows in `docs/architecture/fabric-artifacts-inventory.md`, and the EPI/WGI 'open dataflow -> Refresh' steps in `run-bronze.md` already flagged inline there.

`.claude/support/decisions/decision-004-pipeline-failure-propagation-topology.md` is handled deliberately, NOT edited inline: its coverage arithmetic reasons about 8 activities with 3 RefreshDataflow + 2 Copy, while live reality is 10 activities with 4 Copy and 0 RefreshDataflow. It is the canonical rationale for the error handler, so the staleness is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. Per DEC-016 any change routes through `/research` or `/iterate`. Acceptable outcomes: routed, or explicitly recorded as accepted-point-in-time with reasoning.

`.claude/support/documents/error_handling_strategy.md` (a 2026-04-05 design doc whose 'Current Retries' column predates task-011) is either annotated as point-in-time or updated — an explicit decision either way, not silence.
After the fixes, the same repo-wide probe is re-run and its output recorded again, demonstrating the population is closed rather than sampled.
notes: CREATED 2026-07-31, split out of task-048 by user decision (option C) after task-048 escalated at the 3-attempt verification threshold. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: task-048's ENGINEERING is complete and independently verified — pipeline green 10/10 activities, bronze row counts 132/11 confirmed via Delta time travel at pre-migration versions v47/v45, date correction verified on live data, retirement done per rules/feature-retirement.md, 210 tests passing. All 7 of its acceptance criteria passed on all three verification attempts. ONLY cross-file documentation consistency failed. This task carries that remainder.

⚠️ READ THIS BEFORE STARTING — THE FAILURE MODE THAT PRODUCED THIS TASK IS A PROBE-DISCIPLINE FAILURE, NOT A DOCUMENTATION FAILURE. task-048 tried to close this class FOUR times and the root cause migrated one axis each round: (r1) the audit probe was piped through `| head -40` and silently truncated, hiding every consumer under .claude/commands/, .claude/support/documents/ and docs/; (r2) the remediation swept the VERIFIER'S ENUMERATED FILE LIST instead of re-running discovery; (r3) discovery was re-run whole but only on the ITEM NAME (`bronze_azureSQLdb2table`), never the feature class; (r4) the term was correctly widened to the feature class but the SEARCH ROOT was narrowed to `docs/`, so `.claude/support/documents/**` and `.claude/commands/**` were never feature-class swept in any round. Each lesson was written into task-048's notes BEFORE the round that violated it. Prose capture did not prevent recurrence — which is why criteria 1-3 and 7 of this task are about the PROBE rather than about the files.

STANDING RULE this task exists to enforce: an enumeration of defects in a verification report is a SAMPLE of a population defined by a probe, never the population itself. Remediate by re-running the probe, not by closing the listed instances. Truncating output, sweeping a supplied list, narrowing the search term, and narrowing the search root are four faces of the same bug, and all four report as authoritative.

KNOWN INSTANCES AT CREATION (a starting sample — the probe defines the real population, per criterion 3). task-048 slice: medallion_architecture.md:137 ('**Ingestion Methods:** - Dataflow (Azure SQL)', twelve lines below the table task-048 rewrote to name the Copy activities, so the file contradicts itself); data_sources.md:194 (Source->Bronze diagram annotates the Azure SQL path '(dataflow)' while EPI/WGI are annotated '(notebook)' — the annotation IS the mechanism claim); data_sources.md:247-249 and run-bronze.md:107-110 (the operational runbooks, criterion 0); data_sources.md:11 ('**Authentication:** (TBD - verify in dataflow connection)' although the answer, Fabric connection `oem_azuresql_procurement`, is stated 29 lines below); data_sources.md:268 ('the next pipeline run overwrites bronze from the dataflow'); orchestration.md:261 ('Bronze ingestion: Dataflow refresh times' as a current bottleneck, in the doc task-048 rewrote from live state); run-full-pipeline.md:213 ('Verify dataflow connections are configured correctly' as bronze-stage triage, in a file task-048 rewrote); error_recovery_playbook.md:76 (Symptoms still reads 'on the procurement dataflow' inside a section task-048 otherwise corrected).

GROUND TRUTH for anything that needs re-deriving: the pipeline has 10 activities — 6 bronze (bronzecopy_EUSupplyShares, bronzecopy_GlobalSupplyShares, bronzecopy_procurement_transactional, bronzecopy_supplier_ref all Copy retry=3/300s; bronze_WGI, bronze_EPI both TridentNotebook retry=2/30s), then bronze-to-silver (retry 2/120s, depends on all 6), silver-to-gold (2/120s), data_quality_checks (1/120s), pipeline_error_handler (0/30s, runs on every outcome). ZERO RefreshDataflow. Azure SQL is read via Fabric connection oem_azuresql_procurement (da9667d6-9df0-492e-83e0-de4a55fc388e), shared with security group Fabric-SPN-Access (dbe8361c-5810-4e35-8958-6d1b7cdd3680). The dataflow item 47f7a4ab-2b69-4275-8171-1f6bd55b25e4 is DELETED — REST GET returns 404. Only EPI_file2table and WGI_file2table remain as Dataflow items, and neither is on the pipeline's activity path.

DO NOT re-open task-048's engineering. Do not touch pipeline-content.json, the Copy activities, the connection, correct_procurement_date, its tests, or the retirement snapshot. This task is documentation only. The one code file listed in files_affected (bronze-to-silver notebook-content.py) is there solely for the stale task-035 instruction inside an error string at ~line 624.

Bronze holds the source's RAW day/year-transposed dates by design — a Copy activity cannot transform, so the correction runs in bronze-to-silver. Any doc describing bronze procurement dates as usable is wrong; point readers at silver.

[IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-01] implementation_status: completed. 14 files modified, all 8 acceptance criteria met, 210 tests pass. Decision-004 accepted as point-in-time (criterion 5 option b, DEC-016) — NOT edited inline; recorded here, not as a new DEC (task-scoped disposition, non-blocking, non-architectural).

CRITICAL PROBE-DISCIPLINE FINDING: naive `rg -i 'dataflow'` (no --hidden) returned only 88 hits — ripgrep silently skips ALL hidden dirs by default, so the entire .claude/ tree (304 hits across tasks/commands/support-documents) was invisible. This is the SAME r4 root-narrowing failure mode task-049 exists to enforce against. Corrected by searching explicit dirs (.claude/ + non-hidden tree). Fifth face of the same bug: truncation / supplied-list / narrow-term / narrow-root / hidden-dir-default-exclusion.

PROBE COMMANDS (pre-fix and post-fix used the SAME command for apples-to-apples): `rg -i -n 'dataflow' --no-heading .claude/ .github/ src/ fabric/ tests/ docs/ scripts/ README.md CONTRIBUTING.md project_definition.md nb-pcs-snapshot.md` | `rg -n 'RefreshDataflow' --no-heading <same dirs>` | `rg -n 'bronze_procurement' --no-heading <same dirs>` | `rg -n 'bronze_procurement_transactional' --no-heading <same dirs>` (last is a subtractable subset to derive the non-transactional count).
PRE-FIX COUNTS: dataflow(ci)=392 | RefreshDataflow=89 | bronze_procurement(all)=159 | bronze_procurement_transactional=105 | bronze_procurement(non-transactional)=54.
POST-FIX COUNTS: dataflow(ci)=388 (-4) | RefreshDataflow=90 (+1) | bronze_procurement(all)=161 (+2) | bronze_procurement_transactional=105 (unchanged) | bronze_procurement(non-transactional)=56 (+2).

DELTA INTERPRETATION: raw counts did NOT drop to zero because edits ADDED explanatory past-tense mentions ('the dataflow is retired', 'no dataflow refreshes on the pipeline', point-in-time annotation banners) while REMOVING stale current-state claims ('Verify authentication credentials in dataflow', 'Open dataflow: EPI_file2table', 'Bronze ingestion: Dataflow refresh times', 'Dataflow (Azure SQL)'). Delta analysis (comm -23 / comm -13 on sorted pre/post probe files) confirms every REMOVED line is a stale current-state claim and every ADDED line is past-tense/annotation/corrective. All remaining hits dispositioned EXEMPT (archival / past-tense / generic dataflow-concept / point-in-time-annotated / decision-record / generated / test-fixture / variable-name) or DEFERRED (table-name drift). No hit unclassified.

PATH EXCLUSIONS: NONE in the recorded probe (explicit-dir enumeration includes .claude/ — the load-bearing dir r4 missed). Earlier exploratory `rg` without --hidden silently excluded .claude/ (88 vs 392) — r4 failure recurring, basis of the template_gap friction marker.
